* WHITEWASHING A CELLAR WALL IS A COMMON PRACTICE TO PREVENT FROST AND MOLD IN WINTER  
* IT HELPS TO KEEP THE CELLAR CLEAN AND PREPARED FOR SPRING SEEDS AND PLANTS  
* THE PROCESS INCLUSES APPLYING A THICK COAT OF WHITELASH TO THE WALLS AND BASEMENT  
* IT IS IMPORTANT TO ALLOW TIME FOR THE WHITELASH TO SET BEFORE USE OR USE IN THE SPRING  
* THIS ACTION IS A SIMPLE WAY TO IMPROVE THE APPEARANCE AND FUNCTION OF THE CELLAR.
